Description: This is a shared space used by the development team to collaboratively develop apps. Master copies of production apps are maintained in this space. To create a new version of an app
column5: the master copy should be duplicated rather than overwritten.

Name: Space1 (STAGE)
Description: Master copies of production apps are maintained in this space. To create a new version of an app, the master copy should be duplicated rather than overwritten.

Name: Space1 (ETL)
Description: This is a managed space containing published ETL applications. The apps published to this space should be restricted to production ETL apps that do not provide a front-end interface to end users.
